name: Magna Carta design tokens
description: Resolver for the Magna Carta design-token source: primitive ramps + semantic aliases (the light/default truth), modified by theme and mode. Mode overlays re-point semantic aliases to ramp positions and are shared across all themes; a new theme adds one context that swaps ramp values only.

primitives.description: Primitive scales: color ramps, dimensions, typography, shadows, z-index, motion.

semantic.description: Semantic aliases onto primitives; the only names components consume.

theme.description: Visual theme (firm-picked). chancery is the flagship default (Ink & Gold, baked into the primitives); each showcase theme adds one context that swaps the neutral+brand ramp VALUES only. The shared accent (gold) and status ramps never vary by theme.

mode.description: Light or dark color mode, shared across all themes. Light is empty: tokens/semantic.json is the light/default truth. Dark re-points color-bearing semantic aliases to other ramp positions.

contrast.description: Reserved high-contrast axis (design language §6; the home for stronger boundaries + OS prefers-contrast / forced-colors). Unpopulated at launch — only the no-op 'standard' context exists; a future 'high' context strengthens borders and drops subtle shadows. The plugin permutations (terrazzo.config.mjs) emit theme x mode only, so this resolves to its default and adds no output until populated.
